hook.text: Day 1 again. 9th time this year. Is Allah tired of you?

verses.text: “Do not despair of the mercy of Allah.”

end.text: Day 1 again. 9th time this year. Is Allah tired of you?
end.gold: Tonight at Isha: go back. Day 1 is still a day.

captions: 5:52 p.m. The train home. Rain on the window.
Your reflection looks tired. You did it again.
You open your notes: “Day 1.” The ninth one.
And a voice whispers: why would He forgive you now?
Isha. You walk in late. Wet jacket. Last row.
In sujood you whisper: “I'm back. Again.”
He never closed the door. Not once.
